title: Friday decision memo
prompt:
Use the venture-chief-of-staff skill.

Friday decision memo, following templates/weekly-decision-memo.md.

Include only: evidence that is new or was invalidated this week; a one-page scorecard per active thesis; the leads and outreach drafts that are genuinely ready for founder review; one reusable AI or product artifact; and the explicit decisions you need from me, each with the option you recommend.

Leave out anything that does not change a decision. Cite record IDs throughout. Draft only: no outreach, spend, pricing, legal conclusions or commitments.
